title: Transactions (advanced)
summary: All-or-nothing changes: commit, rollback and why two writes must share one transaction.
body:
All-or-nothing changes: commit, rollback and why two writes must share one transaction.

Why it matters: A transfer is two writes. If only one lands, money is created or destroyed. A transaction makes the pair atomic: both commit, or a failure rolls both back.

SQL ↔ ORM: SQLAlchemy Session.begin() context. Prisma $transaction([...]) or $transaction(async (tx) => …). SQL BEGIN … COMMIT (the lab wraps your script for you).
why: A transfer is two writes. If only one lands, money is created or destroyed. A transaction makes the pair atomic: both commit, or a failure rolls both back.
objectives: Group related writes in one transaction.
Python: `with Session(engine) as s, s.begin():` — Prisma: `$transaction` — SQL: BEGIN/COMMIT.
pitfalls: Two separate sessions/calls for one logical change.
Using the global client inside a Prisma interactive transaction.
mappingNotes: SQLAlchemy Session.begin() context. Prisma $transaction([...]) or $transaction(async (tx) => …). SQL BEGIN … COMMIT (the lab wraps your script for you).
teachAlong: Cause: All-or-nothing changes: commit, rollback and why two writes must share one transaction.
Effect: run the exercise and read the gate's rule ids.

example.code:
with Session(engine) as s, s.begin():
    alice.balance -= 30
    bob.balance += 30

exercise.prompt: Transfer 30 from alice to bob atomically, then attempt a 500 transfer that must roll back completely.
exercise.hint: `with Session(engine) as s, s.begin():` commits on success and rolls back on any exception.

from sqlalchemy import String, Integer, Numeric, Boolean, ForeignKey, UniqueConstraint, create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column, relationship


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass



from decimal import Decimal
from sqlalchemy import CheckConstraint, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


class LabL15Account(Base):
    __tablename__ = "lab_l15_accounts"
    __table_args__ = (CheckConstraint("balance >= 0", name="ck_l15_balance"),)
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    owner: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), unique=True)
    balance: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(10, 2))


engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL)
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)

with Session(engine) as session, session.begin():
    session.add_all([LabL15Account(owner="alice", balance=Decimal("100")), LabL15Account(owner="bob", balance=Decimal("0"))])

exercise.solution:
from sqlalchemy import String, Integer, Numeric, Boolean, ForeignKey, UniqueConstraint, create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column, relationship


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass



from decimal import Decimal
from sqlalchemy import CheckConstraint, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


class LabL15Account(Base):
    __tablename__ = "lab_l15_accounts"
    __table_args__ = (CheckConstraint("balance >= 0", name="ck_l15_balance"),)
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    owner: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), unique=True)
    balance: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(10, 2))


engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL)
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)

with Session(engine) as session, session.begin():
    session.add_all([LabL15Account(owner="alice", balance=Decimal("100")), LabL15Account(owner="bob", balance=Decimal("0"))])

# Move 30 from alice to bob: both updates commit together, or neither does.
with Session(engine) as session, session.begin():
    alice = session.scalars(select(LabL15Account).where(LabL15Account.owner == "alice")).one()
    bob = session.scalars(select(LabL15Account).where(LabL15Account.owner == "bob")).one()
    alice.balance -= Decimal("30")
    bob.balance += Decimal("30")

# A transfer that would overdraw alice fails as a whole — bob must not receive anything.
try:
    with Session(engine) as session, session.begin():
        alice = session.scalars(select(LabL15Account).where(LabL15Account.owner == "alice")).one()
        bob = session.scalars(select(LabL15Account).where(LabL15Account.owner == "bob")).one()
        bob.balance += Decimal("500")
        alice.balance -= Decimal("500")
except Exception as e:
    print("rolled back:", type(e).__name__)

wrongSolutions.label: credit and debit in separate transactions (bob keeps the 500)
